heroHeadline: White House Calls Iran Draft MOU a 'Fabrication'; Trump Says Deal in 'Final Stages' — Day 88 of US-Iran War
heroSubtitle: On May 27, 2026 (Day 88), White House officials denied Iranian state media's leaked draft MOU as 'not true' and a 'fabrication,' while Trump privately told allies the deal is in 'final stages' and will be announced 'shortly.' VP Vance said he was 'extremely hopeful' Tehran would disavow nuclear weapons; Khamenei advisor Shamkhani called Trump's nuclear demand a 'fantasy.' The central gap remains: the US demands a 10-12 year enrichment moratorium and full HEU transfer; Iran's position is a 5-year suspension. Brent crude seesawed $100-104/bbl on the mixed signals. On May 26, the Supreme Court sided with Trump — reversing the 4th Circuit — in a case upholding restrictions on immigration judges' speech, while Trump led Memorial Day ceremonies at Arlington National Cemetery honoring the seven US service members killed in the Iran conflict. New polling released May 26 put Trump's approval at a fresh second-term low: 37% (Verasight, net -23), 31% (ARG), and a net of -47 on inflation handling. Democrats now lead the generic congressional ballot by +8. DNI Tulsi Gabbard (who resigned May 22 citing husband's bone cancer) will be replaced on an acting basis by Aaron Lukas; no permanent successor named yet. The April 8 ceasefire technically holds through Day 88.
